Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of Lenovo LOQ 15 (15IAX9)?

The Lenovo LOQ 15 (15IAX9) features a 65W TGP (with Lenovo LA1 AI Chip & MUX Switch) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050 4GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

Lenovo LOQ 15 (15IAX9) scores 9.1/10 for software engineering. Its Intel Core i5-12450HX (8 Cores: 4P + 4E, 12 Threads, up to 4.4 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
